organic_results.title: Q-HACK INDIA 2026 | Devfolio
organic_results.snippet: Q-Hack India 2026 is a national-level quantum hackathon hosted by QuantumRIT at Ramaiah Institute of Technology, Bengaluru, as part of Quantum Week 2026, a IBM Qiskit Fall Fest program. The hackathon brings together students, developers, researchers and quantum enthusiasts to explore real-world applications of quantum computing.

organic_results.title: Hack-Xplode | Devfolio
organic_results.snippet: Hack-Xplode is a 30-day hackathon event organized by the Department of Artificial Intelligence and Data Science at Chennai Institute of Technology. The primary objective of Hack-Xplode is to foster the development of projects and solutions that address critical issues, both locally and globally.
